events.title: Dreadneck Wednesdays
events.description:
@

Join on Facebook

Featuring local acts! Dreadneck Wednesdays is a weekly reggae event series starring Mau Mau Chaplains—the best regular reggae/ska show in town and the ONLY place to be on a Wednesday night.

The Mau Mau Chaplains assemble several hundred years of collective reggae experience, defining the Sixth St. music scene with Dreadneck Night at Flamingo Cantina every Wednesday for the last decade. The Mau Maus combine four-part harmonies with a driving reggae beat, complete with a full horn section courtesy of the Tijuana Train Wreck. This is, in truth, a professional reggae orchestra. Come check out this unforgettable show!

Plus, authentic Jamaican food cooked up by Winston’s Kitchen!

Can’t make it person to Flamingo Cantina? No worries, there are multiple ways to watch!

Starting around 10:30pm Each Wednesday, you can stream on either Flamingo Cantina’s Facebook or Youtube!

From 11:00pm – 11:30pm Watch on Austin Music TV/ Austin Public Access Channel 16 Spectrum & Grande, Channel 99 AT&T U-verse, Roku App, Apple TV App, Amazon Fire TV (search Austin Public) and on any device.

Brought to you with support in part by the City of Austin’s Live Music Fund Program of Austin Arts, Culture, Music and Entertainment.

events.title: Alborosie – Live in Austin!
events.description:
@

Tickets
Join on Facebook

Get ready for an unforgettable night of authentic roots reggae as Italian born reggae ambassador Alborosie takes the stage!

Known for his powerful vocal delivery, masterful production, and deep respect for traditional Rastafarian culture, Alborosie brings his international sound to the Good Vibes Oasis for a massive Friday night show! Experience a dynamic performance tracking Alborosie’s massive catalog of hits, fusing classic analog dub with modern dancehall rhythms.

Winston’s Kitchen will be on hand with Caribbean fare!

DJ Jah Karma on the ones and twos!

Brought to you with support in part by the City of Austin’s Live Music Fund Program of Austin Arts, Culture, Music and Entertainment.

$40 Limited Early Bird; $50 Advance; $55 Night of show; ages 21+ welcome
